title: Lead-Lag (Discrete or Continuous)
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time lead-lag compensator, 1 input, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Lead time constant, T1}, {Lag time constant, T2}, {Upper saturation limit} sets the state upper limit, {Lower saturation limit} sets the state lower limit, {Initialization} sets the initial state specification Inherited from block and {Initial state}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Upper saturation limit
params.values: State upper limit inf (default) | real number

params.name: Initialization
params.values: Initial state specification Inherited from block input (default) | Specify as parameter
